responsibility: Defines the OpenRISC GNU/Linux target environment layer on top of the generic ELF configuration. It supplies Linux preprocessor builtins, selects the glibc and musl dynamic linker paths, customizes CPP_SPEC and LINK_SPEC for shared/static/static-pie linking behavior, and requests exec-stack marking support at assembler file end, distinguishing Linux userland binaries from the bare-metal ELF and RTEMS variants.
